items.name: Shade Impulse

items.description: These sharp claws remind the user of sharp fingernails.

items.name: Shield of Unending Flame
items.description: This Shield was forged to defend against even the most powerful of fires, however it turned out it worked equally as well with other sources of magic.

items.name: Shinigami Yanki
items.description: Named after the beast of fiery death, these claws inflicts burning pain to the prey's wounds.

items.description: The refined arrows of an infamous ghost hunter.

items.name: Silver Fishing Rod
items.description: A silver fishing rod made to withstand the sheer force of fish bites and tugs. Usable in all fishing from spots from mid level to the lowest level.

items.name: Sinister Staff
items.description: The staff used by cult leaders upon performing deadly rituals. Often using humans as sacrificial lambs to create a link that allows wicked people to envelop their inner demons.

items.name: Skull Staff
items.description: The skull etched at the top of the staff glimmers with an inner fire. It represents power and superiority in magic, and is often held by immensely powerful rogue mages.

items.name: Sky Piercer
items.description: The blade made of pure energy, used by chaos warriors in battling the land of magic. The essence flowing within the blade enhances the user's combat ability by injecting it with the power of chaos which increases their execution prowess.
effects: Passive: Applies a debuff on the enemy per attack that reduces Attack Speed by 20% and deals 30000 magic damage per second

items.name: Slicer
items.description: This weapon is sharp and looks ready to claim the lives of those it pierces.

items.name: Smite
items.description: A weapon from the depths of hell, purified by guardian angels to destroy all enemies at will.
effects: Passive: Every 5th basic attack unleashes a light nova that deals 10,000 Pure Damage to nearby enemies.

items.name: Song of Ice
items.description: Found in the iciest cave in Silvasia, this sword was frozen to absolute zero, making the blade very chilly.
effects: Passive: Frost Attack: Slows the target by 15%.

items.name: Soul
items.description: The soul of a once young adventurer who traded his soul for more power. This soul has shed every fragment of its former self. Pain, memory, and mortal weakness have been consumed, leaving no trace of what once was. What remains is not a continuation, but an entity forged beyond regret and identity. It does not remember the past, nor is it bound by it. The soul now exists as a purer, stronger being, defined only by its will and the power it has become.
effects: Soulbound: Every 4 seconds, damaging an enemy unleashes Caladbolg, dealing [60000 + 200% Int] pure damage to enemies in an area.

items.name: Soul Crystal
items.description: A very powerful crystal with a soul stored inside it. It is said to glow very bright on the brink of the owner's death, protecting the wielder.

items.name: Soulcutter
items.description: A blade that is so sharp that it cuts through the soul of its prey.

items.name: Soulreaper
items.description: The Soulreaper is a creation born from the malevolent ambitions of dark sorcerers. Legends speak of its insatiable hunger for souls, a thirst that grows with each life extingushed by its razor-sharp edge. As the blade reaps through the living, it leaves behind a wake of tormented spirits, forever bound to the Soulreaper's shadowy legacy.

items.name: Soulshot
items.description: The arrow of the fabled Angel Slayer. Its power comes from the pure corruption found in the essence of the legendary Lord of Darkness.
effects: Passive: Third basic attack deals [8000 + 40% Agi] Pure Damage in an AOE and reduces armor by 15 for 1.5 seconds.

items.name: Sovereign Sword
items.description: The sword of the Almighty Ruler of the First Kingdom. Blessed by the angels, this sword wields divine power, the ability to take the sould of its victim as betrayal of the angel's orders.
effects: Active: Steals 1.75% of target's total Health (Max: 45% Heal) of target and slows AS and MS by 70% for 3 seconds. Cooldown 40s.

items.name: Spark of Joy
items.description: A highly conductive spark from Joy's hands, this stabilized current of electricity is too potent when fully unleashed. A small zap from the Flash of Miracle would leave you electrocuted for good.

items.name: Spear of Genocide
items.description: The most prized treasure of the Dragon Altar that has witnessed thousands of years of history and grants the owner unrivaled power and the responsibility to guard Cadia Riverlands.
effects: Active: Next 3 basic attacks deal [20 000 + 100% Agility] magic damage to enemies around the target.

items.name: Sphere of Doom
items.description: Misery.

items.name: Staff

items.description: The living staff of the 1st Lord of Chaos. It is known to disobey its owner that do not have enough chaos power and turn its wishes upside down.

items.name: Staff of the Ages
items.description: Only those who are worthy ever understand its true purpose. For those who can't however, still become powerful mages due to its powerful innate energies.

items.name: Staff of the Naga
items.description: The Staff of the Naga is a unique staff; it holds extraordinary power within which, if used properly, could unleash chaos.

items.name: Starlight Crystal
items.description: By synthesizing the power of the elements to the Corrupted Crystal, it envelops the wielder with great regenerative energies.

items.name: Stitches' Dagger
items.description: This is one of the many remains left behind by Stitches, probably from some other traveler who met his dismal end facing this monstrous beast.

items.name: Stitches' Legacy
items.description: This wand was made from BlackGrave magic, and contains superior amounts of magic hidden within it.

items.name: Stitches' Totem
items.description: This totem is actually Stitches head. It is ridiculously heavy, but spellcasters can use magic to resize it. Also, the protection it grants is pretty solid.

items.name: Stone of Vsmir
items.description: The curious stone of Vsmir is said to hold extraordinary powers for the strong-minded - a true gem.

items.name: Storm Sanctuary
items.description: The magical tool used by heroes to exit the dark reflection of the present time.
effects: Active: Toggles between 'all attacks' or 'boss-only attacks' for passive to proc.
Passive: Negate one instance of Physical Damage and grants 1,200 Armor for 2.5 seconds. Cooldown 25s.

items.name: Stout Shield
items.description: This stout shield provides minimal defence against attacks, but at least everyone can use it.

items.name: Strength of the Earth
items.description: Written in draconic language, it contains forbidden spells that allow the summoning of dragon elementals.
effects: Passive: Basic attacks deal (6000 + 3% Max HP) bonus magic damage.

items.name: Sun Orb
items.description: The orb which retains the power of the sun to grant the vitality for the wielder.

items.name: Superior Vizima Gauntlets
items.description: These gauntlets are very steady and well made, allowing for superior protection as well as easier thrusting of attacks.

items.name: Superior Wand
items.description: This wand has a cut above the average wands sold on the market - it is sharper and more durable.

items.name: Swiftblade
items.description: Forged using the power of Eurus, the god of wind, the Swiftblade is infused with the flow of wind that allows the wielder to gain swiftness.

items.name: Sword of Akasha
items.description: Found in the World of C. It is commonly depicted as floating in billowing clouds with no land or sky in sight. This is revealed to be merely an illusion that hides the sword's true power, the power to kill the Gods.
effects: Passive: every other basic attack reduces target's armor by 1, up to 35.

items.name: Sword of the Occult
items.description: The chosen weapon for performing occult rituals. A great evil energy glows from within, tainting the intent of the wielder for demonic purposes.
effects: Passive: Spellcast increases next 3 basic attacks to deal 145% of total Damage. Cannot occur again until all attacks are consumed.

items.name: Sword of Valhalla
items.description: Forged in the divine fires of the mythical Valkyr Smithy, the Valhalla Blade is said to be a gift from the gods themselves to the champions destined for the grand feasts of Valhalla.
effects: Passive: doubles damage bonus for 5 seconds when attacking enemies with below 40% HP.

items.name: Synergy Blade
items.description: The Synergy Blade is an unusual blade; its past is shrouded in mystery and its craftmanship questioned. But none doubt its battle prowress.

items.description: Radiating an ethereal luminescence, the Tear of the Goddess is a necklace that embodies the divine essence of untarnished virtue.

items.name: The Ark Royal
items.description: The Ark Royal, named after the powerful Templar Carrier, is an energy blade. It can cut through almost anything, making it the perfect killing machine.

items.name: The Executioner
items.description: This Decapitator was made for one sole purpose: to execute all who dare oppose the wielder.

items.name: The Grandfather
items.description: The Grandfather is a colossal axe with extremely powerful enchantments branded into its edge. With this axe, the warrior gains speed, damage, and defense in battle, provided he has the strength to wield it first.

items.name: The Heart of Evo
items.description: The Heart of Evo, crystallized after his downfall at the Battle of Emerald Hills. It still retains much of his vitality, even after so long.

items.name: The Impaler
effects: Passive: Every other basic attack deals bonus 5,500 Pure Damage.

items.name: The One's Head
items.description: The head of the Leviathan.

items.name: The Patriarch
items.description: This powerful sword is widely known for the Battle of the Gods, where it was used to strike down Mars himself.

items.name: The Pendant of Nagre
items.description: Nagre was one of the most mighty sages studying the mysteries of the Rite of Passage, but the mysteries of the heavens were never meant to be understood, so before he went insane, he left behind his pendant as his final legacy.

items.name: The Psionic Razor
items.description: Fashioned in a way similar to an assassin's weapon, this weapon has been nicknamed "The Razor", because of its fast paced strikes with the firepower to match.

items.name: The Secret 1
items.description: Not really sure what this is...

items.name: The Spirit Shroud
items.description: This ghostly shroud of armor is extremely light yet gives superior defence, making it extremely useful.

items.name: The Vanquisher
items.description: A sword that resonates with the echoes of countless victories. Its blade, gleaming with an ethereal light, tells the tale of adversaries laid low and challenges overcome. The hilt, adorned with symbols of valor, serves as a constant reminder of the indomitable spirit of those who wield it. As a weapon steeped in the legacy of champions, it is a testament to the unwavering resolve of those who dare to face adversity and emerge victorious.
effects: Passive: Spellcasts increase next 3 basic attacks to deal 160% damage. Cannot occur again until all attacks are consumed.

items.name: Time Sabres
items.description: Crafted beyond human time, the Time Sabres has proven to be one of the most powerful weapons used in ancient history.

items.name: Titan's Mitt

effects: Passive: Basic attacks have a 20% chance to deal (40 000 + 20% Max HP) as Magic Damage to the target.

items.name: Tomahawk Axe
items.description: Forged in the heart of the untamed mountains, the Ogre Tomahawk is a weapon that reflects the raw, brutal strength of the ogre tribes. Hewn from the densest ironwood and adorned with crude, tribal markings, this imposing tomahawk embodies the essence of primal ferocity. The weapon's hefty weight and razor-sharp edge make it a devastating choice for those who seek to unleash the unbridled power of the wind. With each swing, the Ogre Tomahawk echoes the ancestral roars of the mountain clans, leaving no doubt about its wielder's affiliation with the untamed forces of nature.

items.name: Tome of the Unlife
items.description: This Book's secrets explain in depth the mysteries of death and the afterlife.

items.name: Tooth of Belial
items.description: Used by the famed Guild Assassin, James Akida, the Tooth of Belial is known to be the "Angel of Death", because of its superior speed adjustments, godly damage outputs, and powerful enchantments that makes the wielder nearly impossible to hit.

items.name: Windforce
